purpose: I want to create a desktop app for writing books. The idea is that the app is an entire publishing company from draft to ebook - with each role of the company filled by AI agents. The app should be minimalistic and elegant but full of features that you would find in Reedsy or Scrivener. I want to employ workspaces for each author/pen name, so that manuscripts are organized by their respective author/pen name, and I want a built in outline workshop feature that facilitates an environment for building the bones of their manuscript.

principles.text: Signing in is optional: the app is usable without an account.
